spec.title: Dystrybuanty zbioru treningowego i zbioru produkcyjnego

spec.rawSql:
WITH training_buckets AS (
    SELECT 
        FLOOR(x / 0.1) as bucket,
        COUNT(*) as count
    FROM training_dataset
    GROUP BY bucket
),
training_cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        bucket * 0.1 as x_value,
        SUM(count) OVER (ORDER BY bucket)::float / SUM(count) OVER () as cdf,
        'Training' as dataset
    FROM training_buckets
)
SELECT x_value, cdf, dataset FROM training_cumulative

spec.title: dystrybuanta X z produkcji ostatnie 1200 próbek

spec.rawSql:
WITH recent_predictions AS (
    SELECT x
    FROM predictions
    ORDER BY timestamp DESC
    LIMIT 1200
),
production_buckets AS (
    SELECT 
        FLOOR(x / 0.1) AS bucket,
        COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM recent_predictions
    GROUP BY bucket
),
production_cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        bucket * 0.1 AS x_value,
        SUM(count) OVER (ORDER BY bucket)::float / SUM(count) OVER () AS cdf,
        'Production' AS dataset
    FROM production_buckets
)
SELECT x_value, cdf, dataset 
FROM production_cumulative
ORDER BY x_value;
